media.title: Flag of the Philippines (1936–1985, 1986–1998).svg
media.credit:
The design was taken from Executive Order No. 20, s. 1936 and exact colors from the official website of the National Historical Commission of the Philippines based on the January 24, 1955 construction sheet approved by the Philippine Heraldry Committee for the purpose of standardizing the specifications of the flag.[1][2][3]
